publisher.name: ExamLeaf
publisher.rule: Publisher metadata only (channel owner, copyright, sidecar `publisher`, C2PA producer, MP4 artist/copyright tags). Never on screen, never spoken, never in a video title or filename.

header_lockup.rule: PD-21: opening ident only. The brand sticker 'Professor Diki Simplified' is on screen from frame 0 with the complete board and gone by 2.5 s; the end card carries the wordmark; no brand mark sits in the lesson frames. The lesson code is metadata only (no on-screen header).

disclosure_line.A: Performed by {{PERFORMER}}; voice converted with AI

disclosure_line_pattern.A: Performed by [^;·{}]+ ?[;·] voice converted with AI

end_card.note: The end card carries the brand line and the free-lesson line (PD-20). The full RD-45 disclosure sentence goes in the description and the export field ai_voice_disclosure. Never use Path A wording on Path B audio.
end_card.disclosure_placement: PD-20: the AI-content declaration lives in the platform's AI-content label at upload and in the description/sidecar `ai_voice_disclosure` (RD-45 template). It is never on screen and never spoken. `disclosure_line` below is kept for the description template and for Path A credits only.

spoken.outro_rule: The last spoken line of every educational video, exactly this text, after the final question or CTA. No other brand words are spoken anywhere.
cta_options: The worked example is in the free lesson below.
spoken.cta_rule: At most one CTA line, after the transfer question has been answered and before the outro line; never a purchase prompt, never an engagement prompt (subscribe, like, share). ac0: no CTA.

description_template.first_line_rule: One truthful sentence naming exactly what the video teaches (PACKAGING §4.1); computed numbers only.

disclosure_sentence.B: AI-generated narration; script by {{SCRIPT_AUTHOR}}; reviewed by {{REVIEWER}}.
disclosure_sentence.A: Performed by {{PERFORMER}}; voice converted with AI tools; reviewed by {{REVIEWER}}.
disclosure_sentence.A_direct: Narrated by {{PERFORMER}}; no AI voice processing; reviewed by {{REVIEWER}}.

description_template.disclosure_rule: Exact 07/06 §6.4 templates. SCRIPT_AUTHOR is a named person or 'the Professor Diki Simplified team', never 'ExamLeaf'.
description_template.publisher_line_rule: Optional last line; the only place ExamLeaf may appear in audience-readable copy.
description_template.hashtags: At most 3, from the approved string table (class, board/exam label, subject or topic). No claim, trend, engagement or brand hashtags.

forbidden.label: ExamLeaf
forbidden.reason: Founder rule (16 Oct 2026): the audience-facing identity is only Professor Diki Simplified; ExamLeaf stays in publisher metadata.

forbidden.label: guarantee
forbidden.reason: Playbook trust rule: no exam or outcome guarantees (07/05 SH6 'Never' list).

forbidden.label: full marks
forbidden.reason: A marks promise; the playbook forbids exam promises and score claims.

Fabricated certainty or success percentage; the playbook forbids invented statistics. A science value of 100 % must be phrased another way (e.g. 'all of it') or approved by the academic reviewer as a release waiver.

forbidden.label: always comes in the exam
forbidden.reason: Implies knowledge of future papers; an exam promise (C03 guard: no claim that one exact question will appear).

forbidden.label: mind blown
forbidden.reason: Stock AI hype phrase named by the external audit; the voice direction bans it.

forbidden.label: let us embark
forbidden.reason: Stock AI phrase named by the external audit; generic and slow.

forbidden.label: it's that simple
forbidden.reason: Stock AI phrase named by the external audit; it also tells a struggling learner they should already find it easy.

forbidden.label: super teacher (as a public name)
forbidden.reason: Super Teacher is the internal persona and style name; it is never a public name, title or on-screen label. Persona ids in config files are not scanned.

scan_scope: brand_check.py scans: spoken text (script.json beats[].text and narration/timeline.json words), on-screen text (scene text nodes outside <script>, <style>, <title>, plus the fixture values bound by data-fx), fixture string values, script.json title/topic/video_id, render/*.mp4 filenames and their MP4 title tag.

decisions.PD-14: Spoken close is exactly two sentences: 'Try the free lesson on <topic>.' then 'Professor Diki Simplified.' A light, claim-free 'next one' tease before them is allowed; sales lines to students are not.
decisions.PD-12: Separator in end-card lines is '·'; '100%' is forbidden in claim text only (fixture science values exempt).
decisions.PD-20: No 'AI-generated' line on screen or spoken; declaration at upload (platform label + description).
decisions.PD-21: Brand at the start (opening ident ≤ 2.5 s) and on the end card only; the persistent header lockup is retired.
